save.reason: G602 is a HID++ 1.0 device (libratbag Driver=hidpp10); it does not expose the modern feature 0x8100 sector protocol this app's writer uses, so writes stay disabled until a real HID++ 1.0 profile read/write path is implemented and verified against hardware

notes: G602's additional thumb controls are intentionally neutral labels because the mouse is no longer documented with a G4-G11 diagram.
productID is the mouse's own nano-receiver USB ID (0x402C), not 0xC537, which is the separate 'Cordless Mouse Receiver' dongle ID and does not identify this mouse.

This file previously claimed modern feature-0x8100 support pending confirmation; libratbag's driver source (src/hidpp20.c, HIDPP20_QUIRK_G602) confirms G602's only HID++2.0-style feature usage is the separate Adjustable DPI feature (0x2201, with a device-specific sensor-index/value quirk), not onboard profile storage, which stays HID++ 1.0. The live engine already fails this safely today (device_feature_index in hid_transport.c returns REPLY_PROTOCOL_ERROR when feature 0x8100 isn't present), but the JSON should not claim capability the app cannot actually deliver.
